question: Which syllable is identified as the summit bead of the rosary?
premises: The letter kṣa is well known in this context
The rosary has a summit bead called meru
The letter kṣa is called that meru
inference: The letter kṣa is designated as the meru of the rosary.
plain_english: Thus the well-known letter kṣa is called the meru, the summit bead of the rosary.
